concurrent: .concurrent

MouseEvent: 1
KeyEvent: 2
Stop: 0
handle_mouse(event): :: event
handle_key(event): :: event
produce(events, key: int, stop: int):
    events.put(key)
    @: events.put(stop)

events: concurrent.queue()
events.put(MouseEvent)
p: concurrent.process(produce, events, KeyEvent, Stop)
(event: events.get()) ??>
    MouseEvent => handle_mouse(event)
    KeyEvent => handle_key(event)
    Stop => @|

p.join()

rows.source:
stat: .stat

detectors: [0..3]_p
energy: (([0..256] - 128) / 128)_u
spectra: 1 + (1 + detectors_p)/(1 + 100energy_u^2)

contrasts: stat.ptp_u(spectra)
choose_detector(best, candidate):
    contrasts.(candidate) > contrasts.(best)? @: candidate
    best
selected_site: reduce_p(choose_detector, detectors, 0)

:: contrasts
:: selected_site

curve_energy: ([0..512] - 256) / 256
selected: 1 + (1 + selected_site)/(1 + 100curve_energy^2)

:: selected.(256)

view: .ui.viewport
view.add(x: curve_energy_u, y: selected_u, color: [0.25, 0.72, 1, 1])
view.push(axis_type: "Crosshair", grid_mode: "Dots", x_lim: [-1, 1], y_lim: [0, 6], x_label: "Energy", y_label: "Intensity")
view.show()

la: .linalg

c: la.solve([[1, 0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1, 1], [0, 1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 2, 3]], [0, 1, 0, 0])

path(t, a, b, d, e): a + b*t + d*t^2 + e*t^3

slope: deriv_t(path)

:: c
:: path(0.5, c.0, c.1, c.2, c.3)
:: slope(0.5, c.0, c.1, c.2, c.3)

t: [0..256] / 256

curves: .ui.viewport

curves.add(x: t_u, y: path(t_u, c.0, c.1, c.2, c.3), color: [0.25, 0.72, 1, 1])
curves.add(x: t_u, y: slope(t_u, c.0, c.1, c.2, c.3), color: [1, 0.45, 0.18, 1])
curves.push(axis_type: "Open", grid_mode: "None", x_label: "t", y_label: "Position / slope")
curves.show()

phase: .ui.viewport

phase.add(x: path(t_u, c.0, c.1, c.2, c.3), y: slope(t_u, c.0, c.1, c.2, c.3), color: [0.3, 0.9, 0.55, 1])
phase.push(axis_type: "Crosshair", grid_mode: "Lines", x_label: "Position", y_label: "Slope")
phase.show()

# Place three native mathematical annotations on fixed anchor segments.
view: .ui.viewport

dispersion: [[60, 80], [65, 80]]
view.add(p: dispersion_ic, text: "\$x_i^2+a^{n+1}+e^{i\\pi}=0\$", color: [0, 0, 0, 1], label_color: [0, 0, 0, 1], anchor: [0, 0])
ratio: [[60, 200], [65, 200]]
view.add(p: ratio_ic, text: "\$\\frac{a}{b}\$", color: [0, 0, 0, 1], label_color: [0, 0, 0, 1], anchor: [0, 0])
offset: [[60, 320], [65, 320]]
view.add(p: offset_ic, text: "\$\\alpha+x_i\$", color: [0, 0, 0, 1], label_color: [0, 0, 0, 1], anchor: [0, 0])

view.push(axis_visible: false, grid_mode: "None")
view.show()
